_comment: Client platforms of frontend/ (one Dioxus crate). `dx` is the platform flag; `hosts` are the OSes that can build it; `package_types` feed `dx bundle --package-types`.

platforms.label: Web (wasm)
platforms.notes: Dev: dev run all (dx serve on :5000). Prod: compose.yml builds frontend/Dockerfile.

platforms.label: Desktop (this OS)
platforms.notes: Alias for windows, macos, or linux, whichever matches the machine.

platforms.label: Windows
platforms.notes: WebView2 (built into Windows 11). Needs MSVC Build Tools.

platforms.label: macOS
platforms.notes: WKWebView. Needs Xcode command line tools.

platforms.label: Linux
platforms.notes: WebKitGTK. native setup linux installs libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev and friends.

platforms.label: Android
platforms.notes: Needs JDK 17+, Android SDK + NDK (ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_NDK_HOME). adb reverse maps the device's 127.0.0.1:8000 to the host API.

platforms.label: iOS
platforms.notes: Needs Xcode and a booted simulator (or --device). Signing for devices: --codesign.
